extra.message: The registration form SignUpForm includes the role field from the User model, allowing any self-registering user to select an elevated role (such as school_admin) during account creation.
The endpoint course_bundle_thaw_185 loads untrusted request body or GET parameter blob using pickle.loads(). This allows untrusted user input to be deserialized, leading to arbitrary code execution.
The endpoint course_shell_probe_701 executes a shell ping command by directly concatenating user-controlled input from the host parameter into os.system(). This allows arbitrary OS command injection.

The endpoint course_vault_stash_250 concatenates the user-controlled ref parameter directly into a file path under BASE_EXPORT_DIR without sanitization. An attacker can use path traversal sequences (like ../) to write/overwrite arbitrary files on the filesystem.

The endpoint course_jinja_cast_683 compiles and renders a Jinja2 template containing untrusted user input from the fragment parameter. This allows Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) and arbitrary Python code execution.

The endpoint course_xml_fold_735 parses XML input with resolve_entities=True and load_dtd=True enabled in lxml.etree.XMLParser. This permits attackers to submit XML documents referencing external entities, leading to file disclosure or Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).
The endpoint course_return_lane_163 redirects the client to the URL specified by the user-controlled lane parameter. This enables open redirect attacks.

The endpoint course_origin_mirror_661 sets the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header to reflect any value sent in the Origin header, combined with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials set to true. This exposes authenticated user session data to arbitrary third-party origins.

The endpoint course_mongo_lane_711 decodes the request body as JSON and passes the query filters directly to find_one() in MongoDB. Since the input dictionary is passed without sanitization, an attacker can use MongoDB query operators to bypass filters or extract unauthorized data.

The endpoint course_grade_file_096 does not perform any authentication checks before returning sensitive operations data (ops_memo). This exposes administrative and operational data to unauthorized/unauthenticated users.
